notes:
Mid-market SaaS (B2B) product team evaluating Redwood as a migration path from their current LLM provider (primarily OpenAI today). Primary drivers: lower inference unit cost at scale, predictable latency for live chat, and stronger private deployment options for upcoming regulated customers. Team is engineering-first; PM-led purchase. Key quote from CTO: "We need token-cost visibility + no surprises in prompt regressions when we switch vendors."

POC approach: start on Redwood Hosted (openai-compat endpoints) to validate prompt parity, then transition to Dedicated reserved capacity for steady-state throughput and cost predictability. Interested in Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization to shave unit costs.

Technical needs / constraints:~ 99th %-ile message latency < 200ms for short chat flows, peak steady throughput ~120 reqs/s for embeddings + chat combined, cost target ~50% reduction vs current unit cost (or ARR savings in-band). Large prompt templates (average 1.2k tokens) used for context + dynamic system instructions; KV cache behavior important.

Security / compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, KMS integration for keys, retention controls and ability to pin model variants for audit. Data residency requirement for EU customers (may require Dedicated in region).

POC findings so far (hosted): latency baseline improved 15% at 512-token window, batching helped throughput but introduced rare tail spikes; 3 of 120 evaluation prompts showed quality regressions vs current provider (category: slot-filling for multi-turn support escalation). Redwood SE reproduced regressions and created REDW-4121 to track. SE recommended small prompt template adjustments and trying model fallback routing; team wants vendor-side compatibility fix before switching templates at scale.

Commercials: interested in a Dedicated committed capacity quote (monthly) with a burst policy and an SLA for latency; initial ARR target range provided. Procurement expects legal + security review (DPA + SOC2 attestation) before approval.

Sales context: AE (Maya) has run pricing workshop with finance (03/03); term sheet draft pending. Next stages: finalize Hosted POC metrics, Redwood to produce canary Dedicated config and cost projection, legal to review DPA.
